# WASP-121 b: solar-shaped XUV + photospheric blackbody at the planet's orbit
# columns: wavelength [A]  flux at the planet [erg cm^-2 s^-1 A^-1]
# reference: Huang et al. (2023), ApJ 951, 123 (2023ApJ...951..123H),
#            section 2.2: the SED shortward of 1700 A is generated from the
#            solar SED and rescaled by the integrated XUV flux; longward of
#            1700 A it is an LLmodels synthetic spectrum.
# proxy 1:   solar SED = Solar Irradiance Reference Spectrum of the 2008
#            Whole Heliosphere Interval (Woods et al. 2009, GRL 36, L01101),
#            column 'March 30 - April 4', 1 A bins, irradiance at 1 au.
# proxy 2:   LLmodels replaced by pi B_lambda(6459 K) x (R_star/a)^2, the
#            blackbody Huang et al. plot in their Figure 1 for this band.
#            It carries no UV line blanketing; see the WASP-17 variant.
# scaling 1: solar SED x 5.387291e+05 so that F(1-912 A) = 1.6000e+06 erg cm^-2 s^-1
#            at the planet (Huang section 2.2, from Salz et al. 2019, A&A 623, A57,
#            whose XUV is lambda < 912 A: log10 F_XUV = 6.2 from log10 L_X = 30.0
#            through the King et al. 2018 X-ray-EUV relations, section 7).
# scaling 2: Lya window 1206.0-1226.0 A, the line above its local continuum
#            x 2.961511e-02 so that the line flux is 1.000e+05 erg cm^-2 s^-1
#            (Huang section 2.2, from the HD 106516 profile of Wood et al. 2005).
# scaling 3: blackbody diluted by (R_star/a)^2 = 7.095733e-02 with
#            R_star = 1.4572 R_sun and a = 0.02544 au (Huang Table 1).
# join:      one step at 1700.0 A, f(above)/f(below) = 1.1794, measured.
# units:     WHI W m^-2 nm^-1 x 100 = erg cm^-2 s^-1 A^-1.
# coverage:  0.5000 to 4999.5000 A, 5000 rows, strictly increasing.
# caveat:    with F_XUV = 1.6e6 the bands 700-800, 800-912 and 912-1170 A
#            come out about 4.9x above the 1.4e4, 3.6e4 and 6.3e4 that Huang
#            et al. state for their own spectrum; normalizing to their quoted
#            Lyman continuum flux 2.69e5 instead puts all three within 25 per
#            cent. The paper's two statements are not mutually consistent for
#            any solar-shaped SED; the default follows its explicit
#            normalization instruction. Rebuild with --fxuv 2.69e5 for the other.
# built by inputdata/sed/build/build_wasp121b_solar_huang.py
